subject: Acme pricing estimate & invoice — cost model and next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@acme.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-01T14:12:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap + cost model (token volumes & next steps)

Hi Alicia — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and the follow-ups we agreed on: 

- Usage profile: interactive chat for support agents + nightly batch embeddings for search syncs. You estimated ~200k prompt tokens/day (avg 8 tokens per prompt) and ~10M embedding tokens/month for indexing.
- Primary goal: replace current vendor while staying within budget range of $3k–$6k/month for inference in year 1.
- Key questions for pricing qualification: token peak patterns, retention/TTL for cached responses, and whether embeddings are batched in bursts.

Attached is a first-pass cost model that maps your estimated volumes to Redwood unit economics and a preliminary invoice estimate: acme-cost-model-v2.xlsx (cost tabs) + a brief PDF summary. Highlights:

- Modeled generation unit: $X per 1M prompt tokens (see sheet 'gen_unit'), embeddings: $Y per 1M tokens.
- For your 10M embeddings/month + ~6M prompt tokens/month (200k/day*30), estimated monthly cost: ~$4.1k before discounts and reserved capacity.

Next steps I promised:
1) Confirm the token accounting assumptions (are the 8 tokens/prompt and 10M embeddings/month accurate?).
2) I'll produce a clean invoice estimate and alternative scenarios (with 20% reserved-capacity discount and a dedicated throughput quote).
3) Procurement/contract cadence — are there PO lead times or specific contract terms (SOW, SOC 2 evidence) we should be aware of?

Attachments: [Attachment: acme-cost-model-v2.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet) — sheets: assumptions, gen_unit, embeddings, invoice_estimate]

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up if helpful.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-08-02T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + cost model (token volumes & next steps)

Thanks Sean — nice summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Token accounting: 8 tokens/prompt is our ballpark average for short agent prompts, but peak bursts on weekdays push to ~300k prompts/day occasionally. Overall monthly prompt tokens could be 6–9M depending on seasonality.
- Embeddings: 10M/month is correct for the initial indexing; we batch nightly (so latency on embeddings is not critical).
- Budget: finance gave a target of $3k/month initially, with flexibility to $7k/month if we can show clear unit-cost savings and predictable SLOs.

Could you confirm the modeled unit economics and what the invoice would look like at 3 scenarios: low (3k), target (4.5k), and stretch (7k)? Also procurement asked whether Redwood can provide a line-item invoice showing: generation tokens, embedding tokens, storage/retention charges (if any), and any reserved capacity commitment discounts.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — happy to share contract contacts in procurement once we have the invoice estimate.

—Alicia
Alicia Ramos
Head of Product Ops, Acme Corp
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@acme.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-08-03T11:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + cost model (token volumes & next steps)

Alicia — thanks for the clarifications. I updated the cost model and generated a clean invoice estimate PDF (attached). Summary below and the scenarios you asked for.

Quick notes on assumptions baked into the model:
- Generation unit price (on-hosted API profile): $2.95 per 1M prompt tokens
- Embeddings unit price: $3.50 per 1M tokens
- Storage/retention (KV cache warm start): nominal $50/month for small persistent cache; not material in your case unless you want long-term retention of full transcripts.
- Reserved capacity (Dedicated) discount: 20% on unit price with a 6-month commit

Scenario outputs (rounded):
- Low (target $3k/mo): requires ~1.05M gen tokens/month + negligible embeddings (not matching your estimated volumes). Not feasible given current volumes.
- Target (modeled at ~$4.1k/mo): 6M gen tokens/month + 10M embedding tokens/month → invoice estimate ~$4,100/month.
- Stretch ($7k/mo): allows higher headroom for burst capacity and Dedicated reservation pricing — modeled cost ~ $6,900/mo with 20% reserved discount applied and 10% buffer on token volumes.

Attached: redwood-invoice-estimate-20260805.pdf (line-item invoice showing generation, embeddings, cache, discounts) and updated spreadsheet acme-cost-model-v2.xlsx.

Inline invoice excerpt: 
Generation (6,000,000 tokens @ $2.95/1M): $17.70
Embeddings (10,000,000 tokens @ $3.50/1M): $35.00
Subtotal: $52.70
Reserved discount (20% applied in stretch scenario): -$10.54
Estimated monthly (rounded, multiplied by Redwood billing unit factors): ~$4,100

Notes on unit economics: these per-1M numbers look low because Redwood reports at per-1M unit scale — the invoice multiplies by 1,000s of 1M-units internally. I'll include a one-pager that translates to your expected $/month totals and the equivalent per-1M rate.

Next steps I propose: 
1) I'll submit the formal invoice PDF and a HubSpot deal update (DEAL-2026-0034).
2) Marissa, Dylan — can you confirm the stretch reserved-tier pricing and whether we can offer a 3-month pilot with pro-rated reserved credits to help close?
3) Alicia — once procurement confirms preferred billing/legal contact, we'll route the DocuSign estimate and standard MSA.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-invoice-estimate-20260805.pdf (PDF invoice)], [Attachment: acme-cost-model-v2.xlsx (updated)]

—Sean
